频度副词 always / usually / often / sometime: 频度副词表示动作发生的频率;位置是"be 动词之后、实义动词之前",对频率提问用 How often。

频率从高到低:always 总是 > usually 通常 > often 经常 > sometimes 有时 > never 从不|频度副词放在 be 动词之后:She is never late.|频度副词放在实义动词之前:I usually get up at six.|sometimes 可以放句首或句尾:Sometimes I go swimming.|never 本身表示否定,句中不再加 not|对频率提问用 How often:How often do you exercise?
I always brush my teeth before bed.
She is never late for class.
How often do you play basketball? — Twice a week.
column3: 你多久打一次篮球?每周两次。

频度副词 always / usually / often / sometime: We sometimes go swimming on Sundays.

# title: My father ___ watches the news after dinner. He never misses it.
column4: 每天都不错过,频率是 100%,用 always。

# title: Lucy is ___ late for school. In fact, she arrives earliest every day.
column4: 每天到得最早,说明从不迟到;频度副词放在 is 之后。

频度副词 always / usually / often / sometime: He usually gets up at six.|He gets up usually at six.|He usually get up at six.|Usually he get up at six.
column4: 频度副词放在实义动词 gets 之前,且主语 He 后动词要加 -s。

# title: — ___ do you visit your grandparents? — Once a month.
column4: 问频率(多久一次)用 How often。

# title: I ___ eat fast food because it is not healthy.
column4: 快餐不健康,所以从来不吃;never 自身表否定。
